content_judgment.feasibility: For a probability vector beta, the single-example mixed-effect equivalence is exact: Q=E/Tr(E S) is PSD and realizes all trace constraints. Conversely their sum gives Tr(Q S)=1; S positive definite implies Q nonzero, so E=Q/Tr(Q) has trace1 and yields beta. No pure/rank1/circuit conclusion follows.
content_judgment.separating_witness: A relation sum c_t B_t=0 gives c dot beta=0. With ||c||infinity=1, Holder duality proves the stated L1 lower bound. One-sided PSD witnesses follow by positivity of Tr(Q A). Entity anchors and the epsilon term are included, not silently discarded.
content_judgment.global_feasibility: One E shared across the cohort must satisfy the complete normalized homogeneous equations simultaneously. Separate Q_i can each be feasible while no shared E exists. The packet correctly distinguishes this necessary global condition from individual feasibility.
content_judgment.output_preservation: For fixed utilities, preparation, mask, bias and the other39 class logits, preserving this relation logit is exactly Tr(Eprime M_i)=0. With Delta=Eprime-E and trace(Delta)=0, injectivity on the full real tracezero Hermitian space suffices for uniqueness. Rank63 is sufficient but not necessary for pure/circuit families. Nonzero unconstrained null directions need not remain PSD or circuit reachable.
content_judgment.softmax_scope: When all other finite logits are fixed, equal full softmax probabilities imply the selected relation logit is unchanged. Argmax labels alone do not. If other effects, decoder, values or biases change, that conclusion and the fixed-head identifiability result do not transfer.
content_judgment.stability: An orthonormal tracezero Hermitian basis turns Delta into a real vector of equal Frobenius norm. Standard smallest-singular-value control gives the stated inequality. The finite-shift identity obs_i=delta_i*Tr(Eprime S_i) is exact; density positivity bounds the latter by lambda_max(S_i). Numerical near-rank is not exact rank, conditioning or semantics.

This is compatibility with the published head equations, not a claim that frozen RoBERTa produces these h values or that the trained checkpoint realizes the fixture.

The supplied Brunner and restricted-tomography scope comparisons do not claim a refutation or import optimal sample bounds. Thus the M_j span a63-dimensional E-orthogonal hyperplane. Its orthogonal complement is span(E); because Tr(E)=1, that span intersects tracezero matrices only at0. Hence restriction to tracezero is injective, independently of floating-point rank counting.

next_action.why: Current synthetic results settle the proposed broad algebraic interpretations. The remaining useful uncertainty is which actual allocation/utility failure exists relative to stronger and weaker controls, not whether generic PSD/rank identities hold. Descriptive mechanism discovery can precede a new substantive theorem without being mislabeled as confirmation.
before_execution: Specify one operational question and the corresponding input-to-allocation-to-utility-to-logit observables on a fixed training/validation cohort.

Identify exact existing arrays/checkpoints and source/selection identities; do not assume that the necessary detached arrays exist or that recovery/forward is authorized. If evidence is absent, inventory and cost the minimal missing object separately rather than restore indiscriminately.

Match units, mask/roles and output metric across the compared heads. Separately trained Q/classical values and decoders are legitimate comparison objects but remain confounders for a pure allocation attribution. A same-value uniform replay is not the historical independently trained uniform baseline.

Freeze a small selection/matching rule or explicitly label outcome-based strata/cases as exploratory. Preserve improvements, degradations and unchanged cases; do not choose a favorable test-cohort subset.
Treat findings as discovery; predictions proposed after reading those cases need independent validation. Stop if the output is only generic infeasibility/rank counts or a renamed stopped family.
next_action.authority: Recommendation only. No model, dataset, remote, COS, restoration or experiment operation was executed or authorized by this review. Any actual trace extraction/forward/scheduling retains its own project gates.
next_action.not_required: No new formal experiment, new model or new full training run is required merely to validate the algebra. No L5 novelty clearance is imposed as a universal gate on bounded descriptive discovery.

risks.detail: The packet does not establish current existence, accessibility or completeness of a matched trace cohort. The review endorses the research question and scope, not a ready launch.

Global identifiability fixes preparation, values, decoder, bias and other effects. The finite h constructions certify head-interface compatibility, not the image of the actual frozen contextual encoder or end-to-end network uniqueness.

Literature assessment relies on the packet reading receipts and known mathematical reductions. This reviewer did not reacquire or independently read the full cited papers. Exact prior-art exhaustiveness, priority and full-paper conclusions are not certified.

An off-family intermediate intervention remains valid for the named functional-dependence question. Its lack of scorer reachability limits an extrapolated measurement-change claim; it does not erase accepted L4.

Identifiability, source-compatible counterexamples and matching attention traces do not by themselves establish semantic evidence, causal mediation, quantum necessity or a substantive L5 contribution.
